messages:
marie: quick write-up from the afternoon's mini-run — tried a "fast-bridge" prefill variant for the quantized LlamaX-13B-8bit bring-up. high-level: decent perf win, tiny quality hit on some microbenchmarks, possible prefix-bias effect. details below.

sam: nice, can you paste commands + numbers? :eyes:

marie: sure — ran 3 warmup shapes (short chat, long chat, single-turn QA). command I used:```
./run_eval.sh --model llamaX-13B-8q --config configs/prefill_fastbridge.yaml \ 
  --seed 42 --dataset eval/micro_qas.jsonl --batch 8 --out /tmp/fastbridge_run.json
```

marie: raw perf: baseline (no-fastbridge) vs fast-bridge: p50 latency: 45ms -> 28ms (≈1.61x), p95: 210ms -> 131ms (≈1.60x), tokens/sec: 120 -> 185 (+54%). memory stayed flat within measurement noise.

rajesh: those are great numbers for short chats. how about throughput on long sequences?

marie: for 2k context synthetic stream: baseline avg per-token 8.6ms -> 6.1ms with fast-bridge (≈1.41x). so win persists but a bit smaller as kv-cache amortizes.

anya: what about quality? any regressions we should worry about?

marie: microbench QA accuracy (our internal micro_qas): baseline 85.2% -> fast-bridge 84.4% (−0.8pt). Rouge/BLEU negligible changes. Human spot-check: 50 sampled diffs, ~30 were harmless rephrases, ~10 were acceptable alt answers, ~10 borderline (shortening or factual omission).

marie: example diff (prompt elided):
--- baseline: "The protocol uses a two-way handshake to confirm..."
+++ fast-bridge: "It uses a handshake to confirm..."
(comment: meaning preserved but shorter)

sam: could this be a beam/prioritization side-effect? maybe hypothesis: early prefill alters token rank ordering for low-prob tokens when quant noise is present.

rajesh: agree. also check if prefill introduces stale kv-window bias: if the bridge prefetch uses an approximate/fast-softmax path it could slightly alter top-k ordering.

marie: noted. i added a deterministic seed and reran with logging of top-5 logits for first 16 tokens. differences are small but measurable — KL divergence ~0.004 per-token on average.

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline:perf-checker started for job id fb-1729876543 (accepts artifacts in /tmp/fastbridge_run.json)

anya: can you share the minimal repro config? I want to run a 7k-sample holdout.

marie: pasted config snippet:```yaml
# configs/prefill_fastbridge.yaml
strategy: fast-bridge-prefill
bridge_params:
  lookahead: 12
  confidence_threshold: 0.85
  fallback: speculative_fallback
quant: 8bit
batching:
  dynamic: true
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
```

marie: notes on safety: we observed a tiny uptick in hallucination-style short truncations on very long answers when lookahead < 8. with lookahead >= 12 those cases drop back down. so set default lookahead 12 for now.

rajesh: can you run an A/B with lookahead 8 vs 12 on the same seed and dump diffs?

marie: yes — queued a run, should finish in ~45min on the smoke cluster. I'll post outputs.

sam: also add a run with quant-dequant fallback (i.e., force a high-precision roll to confirm quant interaction)

marie: added `fallback: quant-rollback` to the plan.

anya: for the holdout, i'd like: MMLU-subset, micro_qas, and our regen-surge prompt set. aim for p95 latency and exact-match delta thresholds.

marie: agreed. preliminary verdict: promising for latency-sensitive short-turn products (chat widgets, search snippets), but needs the tiny quality mitigation (lookahead >=12 + quant-rollback for selected cohorts). next steps: 1) full 10k-sample sweep with seeds [42, 99, 101], 2) per-route rollout plan (canary 5% session-weight with auto-fallback), 3) write short eval note for onboarding docs.

rajesh: volunteer to own the rollout plan with SRE.

anya: i'll run the holdout sweep and dump diffs into /shared/fastbridge/1729876543/ then we can triage the borderline cases.

marie: thanks — i'll attach the run artifacts when deploy-bot finishes. quick Q: anyone seen any perf regressions on dedicated GPU hosts with multi-tenant batch noise?

sam: not in last week's tests. just watch for cold-starts where prefill might add a small extra CPU op.

deploy-bot: job fb-1729876543 completed: artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-ci/fastbridge/fb-1729876543.tar.gz, perf-report available. :white_check_mark:

marie: uploading a short artifact summary to the eng-ml drive and will turn this into a short checklist for eng-runtime to instrument rollout metrics (p50/p95, exact-match delta, KL token drift).

anya: thumbs up. schedule a 15-min sync tomorrow to decide default lookahead and canary thresholds?

marie: yep — i'll post a calendar invite. thanks everyone. :rocket:
